rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the quality of acting spontaneously or off the cuff.

example.english: The most appealing thing about this play is the actors’ spontaneity, which gives the whole performance vitality.
example.traditional: 呢套劇最吸引嘅地方，就係演員保留咗即興性，成場戲好有生命力。

rows.note: Use this for a particular spontaneous act or pattern of behaviour, rather than the general quality.

example.english: Their spontaneous act of inviting the audience onstage to sing along immediately livened up the whole venue, showing real spontaneity.
example.traditional: 佢突然拉埋觀眾上台一齊唱歌，呢個即興行為令全場即刻熱鬧晒。
